scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays correctly with product name, tagline, description, and call-to-action buttons as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL and wait for page load
steps.context: Initial page load on desktop viewport

steps.description: Check for presence of product logo (logo.gif), tagline, brief description, and CTA buttons
steps.context: Hero section should be visible in first viewport without scrolling

steps.description: Click primary CTA (Get Started/View on GitHub) and verify navigation
steps.context: Buttons should have proper hover states and link to correct destinations

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product logo (assets/logo.gif) is displayed prominently
Tagline displays 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Compatibility' or approved variant
Primary CTA button labeled 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub' is visible and clickable
Secondary CTA button labeled 'Learn More' is visible and clickable
User is navigated to GitHub repository or getting-started section

scenarios.name: Value Proposition Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the three key value propositions (persistence, memcached compatibility, Rust performance) are clearly presented as specified in REQ-2

steps.description: Navigate to the section displaying the three key pillars
steps.context: Section should be easily accessible from hero section

steps.description: Check that Persistence, Compatibility, and Performance pillars are presented as cards or columns
steps.context: Each pillar should have a clear heading and supporting description

test_cases.expected: Card/column displaying 'Persistence' with mention of LSM tree-based storage and WAL for durability
Card/column displaying 'Compatibility' with mention of drop-in memcached protocol support
Card/column displaying 'Performance' with mention of Rust-powered async I/O with Tokio
All three pillars have consistent styling, sizing, and alignment

Feature card mentioning minor and major compaction
Feature card explaining WAL for crash recovery

Feature card describing multiple storage levels with optimized merging
